verdict.rationale: pnpm ships a native `pnpm audit` CLI command that checks installed packages for known security issues, supports `--fix`, and even verifies registry signatures; docs also describe using overrides to force non-vulnerable versions. This directly matches the platform-engineer story of auditing dependencies from the CLI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of `pnpm audit` usage and details on vulnerability database source/severity reporting.
